audience: Sales and support teams that call and text leads from CallHippo

useCases.title: Review call logs for a CRM record
useCases.text: List call logs for a date range, filtered by CRM record or call SID. List users to match agents to the calls.

useCases.title: Check SMS logs by sender or recipient
useCases.text: List SMS logs for a date range, filtered by sender or recipient, and page through the results.

useCases.title: Add or update a contact
useCases.text: Create a contact with a phone number and name, or replace the four contact fields of an existing contact.

useCases.title: Manage the Do Not Call list
useCases.text: Add a number to the Do Not Call list, or remove one. Removing a number can break a customer's opt-out.

useCases.title: Check power-dialer campaigns
useCases.text: List the power-dialer campaigns and read the settings of one campaign.
